attributes.board_name: Texas State Board of Dental Examiners

rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses from providers under TSBDE Rule 104.2 (Board-approved provider list); live interactive webinars count as classroom hours
rules.new_licensee_rule: CE applies after the first biennial renewal and before each subsequent renewal.
rules.carryover: Up to 24 excess classroom/lecture hours earned within the year before the renewal period may be carried forward.
rules.audit_note: Attest at renewal; do not send proof unless asked. About 5% of renewals each month are randomly audited.

topics.who: Dentists with direct patient care: safe and effective pain management related to prescribing opioids and other controlled substances (counts as technical/scientific)
DEA-permitted dentists: prescribing and monitoring controlled substances, within 1 year of obtaining the DEA permit; counts toward the 4 pain-management hours
HHSC-approved human trafficking prevention course, part of the 24 hours
TSBDE Jurisprudence Assessment every 4 years (does not count toward the 24 hours)
Current hands-on BLS; CPR hours do not count

rules.notes: At least 16 h technical/scientific; up to 8 h risk management (records, HIPAA, ethics); up to 8 h self-study. OSHA, CPR and practice finance do not count; ACLS/PALS may count. Current hands-on BLS required. Sedation permit holders: 6/8/12 h on sedation by permit level.
